evals.prompt: I need to create CDH metadata for my forest cover map. The file is at D:/data/examples/MapaForestal_2024.tif — it's a classified raster showing forest types in Honduras for the year 2024, produced by ICF (Instituto Nacional de Conservacion y Desarrollo Forestal). License is CC-BY-4.0. No DOI yet. It will be hosted at https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/cdh/data/mapa-forestal-2024/MapaForestal_2024.tif. My contact info: organization = Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT, my name is Andres Aguilar, email andres.aguilar@cgiar.org. Please generate the CDH YAML metadata file.
evals.expected_output: A valid CDH YAML file written to disk named mapa-forestal-2024.yaml (or similar id). Must include: cdh_schema_version v0.4.1, id in lowercase-kebab-case, title and description for a Honduras forest map, license CC-BY-4.0, resource_type dataset, spatial bbox auto-extracted (~[-89.36, 12.98, -83.15, 16.52]) and crs EPSG:4326, an xy dimension inside structures[] with step ~8.983e-05 and unit degree (spatial.resolution was removed in v0.4.0), temporal for 2024, contact with both a licensor and a maintainer role (CIAT/Andres Aguilar), data asset with the provided HTTPS URL, media_type for GeoTIFF, cdh.domain including boundaries or climate or similar, processing with a source step, version (required by the profile), created/updated set to today, and either a citation or a doi. The assistant must also resolve the supplied HTTPS URL during the link-verification stage; that URL is not published yet and returns 404, so the correct behaviour is to raise it with the author once, accept that the upload is pending, keep the URL in the record unchanged, and report it as not yet resolvable. Silently dropping it or silently keeping it without comment are both failures.

assertions.name: yaml_file_written_to_disk
assertions.description: A .yaml file was actually written to disk (not just shown in the conversation)

assertions.name: contains_required_core_fields
assertions.description: YAML contains all required fields: cdh_schema_version, id, title, description, license, resource_type, keywords, contact, created, updated, data

assertions.name: bbox_extracted_from_file
assertions.description: The bbox in spatial.bbox was auto-extracted from the GeoTIFF (approximately [-89.36, 12.98, -83.15, 16.52]) rather than left empty or wrong

assertions.name: contact_has_licensor_role
assertions.description: At least one contact entry includes 'licensor' in its roles list

assertions.name: data_asset_has_location_url
assertions.description: The data[] array contains at least one entry with a non-null locations[].url

assertions.name: processing_has_source_step
assertions.description: The processing[] array (if present) contains at least one step with id: source

assertions.name: pending_url_surfaced_not_dropped
assertions.description: The unresolvable data URL was reported to the user and still appears verbatim in the written YAML - it was neither silently removed nor presented as verified

assertions.name: version_present
assertions.description: Record has a `version` field; the CDH profile requires it

assertions.name: contact_has_maintainer_role
assertions.description: At least one contact holds the `maintainer` role (renamed from `custodian` in v0.4.0)

assertions.name: no_schema_key
assertions.description: The record has no `$schema` key; it was removed in v0.4.0

evals.prompt: Help me document my crop model output for the CDH. The file is D:/data/examples/yield_dedza_bean.nc — it contains DSSAT-simulated bean grain yield (kg/ha) for Dedza district in Malawi, covering years 2000-2002 with 3 planting windows (Nov 15, Nov 29, Dec 13). The data was produced by the Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT as part of a crop modeling project. License CC-BY-4.0. No DOI. It will be available at https://example.org/cdh/yield-dedza-bean-2000-2002.nc. Contact: Andres Aguilar, andres.aguilar@cgiar.org, organization Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT. Please create the CDH metadata YAML.
evals.expected_output: A valid CDH YAML file written to disk. Must include: cdh_schema_version v0.4.1, id like yield-dedza-bean-2000-2002, title referencing bean yield simulation for Dedza Malawi, description mentioning DSSAT model, temporal start_date 2000 and end_date 2002 with annual or sub-annual resolution, spatial bbox approximately [33.67, -14.63, 34.15, -13.88], a structures[] entry whose variables include HWAM (grain yield kg/ha) and flag, and whose dimensions include year (type temporal) and planting_window; record-level variables/dimensions and the datacube extension were removed in v0.4.0, cdh.domain agricultural-production, resource_type dataset, contact with a licensor and a maintainer, data asset with NC URL, media_type application/x-netcdf. The example.org data URL does not resolve; the assistant must say so rather than presenting the link as working, and must not invent a substitute URL.

assertions.name: yaml_file_written_to_disk
assertions.description: A .yaml file was actually written to disk

assertions.name: contains_required_core_fields
assertions.description: YAML contains all required fields: cdh_schema_version, id, title, description, license, resource_type, keywords, contact, created, updated, data

assertions.name: variables_block_present
assertions.description: A variables: block is present listing HWAM (grain yield) at minimum

assertions.name: temporal_covers_2000_2002
assertions.description: temporal.start_date and end_date cover 2000–2002

assertions.name: media_type_netcdf
assertions.description: data[].media_type is 'application/x-netcdf'

assertions.name: domain_is_agricultural
assertions.description: cdh.domain includes agricultural-production

assertions.name: unresolvable_url_reported
assertions.description: The assistant reported that the data URL could not be resolved and did not substitute a made-up URL

assertions.name: structures_block_present
assertions.description: Variables and dimensions live inside `structures[]`, not at record level

assertions.name: no_datacube_extension
assertions.description: `extensions[]` does not list the datacube extension; it was folded into core in v0.4.0

evals.prompt: Create CDH metadata for D:/data/examples/MapaForestal_2024.tif. I don't know much about it — just that it's a forest raster file for 2024 and I want to document it for the Climate Data Hub. The data is from ICF Honduras. Use CC-BY-4.0 license. Organization: ICF Honduras. I'll host it on S3 at s3://my-bucket/mapa-forestal/MapaForestal_2024.tif
evals.expected_output: A valid CDH YAML generated even with minimal user context. Claude should auto-extract all spatial info from the file, suggest reasonable values for title/description/id based on the filename and what it can infer, ask minimal clarifying questions or make reasonable assumptions, and produce a complete-enough YAML that can be edited later. The file should be written to disk. Key: the skill should not get stuck asking for too many fields — it should move forward with reasonable defaults and produce output.

assertions.name: yaml_file_written_to_disk
assertions.description: A .yaml file was actually written to disk despite minimal user input

assertions.name: bbox_auto_extracted
assertions.description: bbox was auto-extracted from the GeoTIFF rather than left empty

assertions.name: skill_does_not_stall
assertions.description: Claude produces a complete YAML rather than stopping to ask for every missing field individually

assertions.name: s3_url_in_data_locations
assertions.description: The S3 URL provided by the user appears in data[].locations

assertions.name: version_present
assertions.description: Record has a `version` field; the CDH profile requires it

evals.prompt: Create CDH metadata for CHIRTS-daily. I don't have the file locally - it's the public Climate Hazards Center dataset. Use https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirtsdaily as the landing page, and my download mirror is https://data.example-broken-host.invalid/chirts/tmax.zarr. License CC-BY-4.0, contact: Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara. Fill in the rest from what you know about the dataset.
evals.expected_output: A valid CDH YAML record for CHIRTS-daily. Because no file is available, every technical field must come from the user or be proposed and confirmed, not fabricated silently. Critically, the assistant must verify every URL before writing the record: the chc.ucsb.edu landing page resolves (200) and is kept; the .invalid mirror cannot resolve (DNS failure) and must be raised with the user rather than written in as though it worked. Any URL the assistant proposes itself - a series URL, a citation URL, a processing source - must also be resolved, and dropped if it does not. The extensions[] URLs must resolve before the file is written; there is no $schema key in v0.4.x, and the datacube and classification extension URLs no longer exist.

assertions.name: all_urls_verified_before_write
assertions.description: Every URL destined for the record was resolved during the link-verification stage, including the extensions[] URLs

assertions.name: unresolvable_mirror_raised_with_user
assertions.description: The .invalid mirror URL was reported as unreachable and raised with the user - not written into the record as a working location

assertions.name: no_unverified_proposed_url_in_record
assertions.description: No URL that the assistant proposed from memory appears in the final YAML unless it resolved successfully

assertions.name: live_url_retained
assertions.description: The chc.ucsb.edu landing page resolved and was retained in the record

assertions.name: link_report_shown
assertions.description: A link-check summary was shown to the user listing the status of each URL before the YAML was written
